frequency_question: How often do major bipartisan permitting/infrastructure packages proceed from advance visible signals to enactment in a single congressional session?
membership_rule: Includes major, multi-sector energy or environmental permitting reform bills that required bipartisan negotiation and were enacted into law; excludes minor appropriations riders or single-agency authorizations.

cases.name: Moving Ahead for Progress in the 21st Century Act (MAP-21) [permitting titles]
FAST Act (Fixing America's Surface Transportation Act - Title X FAST-41)
Failed 2024 Bipartisan Energy Permitting Reform Act Attempts

coverage_note: 7 major legislative cycles identified representing attempts at comprehensive infrastructure/permitting reform; 5 successfully enacted provisions streamlining reviews.
known_gaps: Excludes minor standalone transmission siting provisions attached invisibly to must-pass omnibus bills without prior standalone signal visibility.
validity_reason: Legislative procedure rules and polarization dynamics evolve slowly over multi-year congressional eras.
